blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A row over lot access and plants being cut ended with a drunk man stabbing and seriously wounding his neighbor, a caretaker of the lot. The attack happened at past 8 p.m. on Sept. 22 in Sitio Binabag, Brgy. Estaca in Compostela town in northern Cebu. The 55-year-old lot caretaker, as of this posting, remained in serious condition at the hospital for several stab wounds in his body.
